description: Bucket-brigade delay with an overdrive stage, a lowpass filter on the repeats, an internal LFO on the delay time and a stereo output pair

params.text: Switches the delay between its long and its short range, the short range being where flanging and ensemble effects come from
Sets how hard the delayed signal is overdriven
Sets the level of the signal going into the delay
Sets how far the internal LFO moves the delay time, and with a cable patched into CV IN it attenuates that voltage instead
Sets the delay time within the range picked by the LONG and SHORT switch
Sets how much of the delayed signal goes back into the delay line
Sets the lowpass filter on the delayed signal, darker turned down and brighter turned up
Balances the dry signal against the delayed signal
Sets the speed of the internal LFO that modulates the delay time

inputs.text: Modulates the delay time, scaled by the CV LEVEL knob, and switches the internal LFO off while a cable is patched here
The audio input to the delay

outputs.text: The right side of the output pair, carrying the dry and delayed signals mixed as the DRY/WET knob sets
The left side of the output pair, carrying the dry and delayed signals mixed as the DRY/WET knob sets

notes: there is no menu of this module's own beyond Rack's; every setting is on the panel
